titulo: Cop31 told it risks being ‘ghost’ summit as all mentions of fossil fuels removed from draft text
cuerpo: Draft agreement also fails to show how developing countries will receive financial help to deal with climate crisis Cop31 live – latest updates Every mention of fossil fuels has been expunged from the draft outcome of global climate talks, which were approaching their final hours on Thursday night , threatening to turn the UN summit into what campaigners called a “ghost Cop”. The second draft of the key text , released on Thursday afternoon and setting out the main commitments from the Cop31 climate summit in Turkey , removed a pledge to phase out fossil fuels and weakened goals on electrification, while other parallel texts failed to flesh out how developing countries would receive the financial help they needed to deal with the climate crisis.
